title: Unsolvable: a destination off the network
query: roads.geojson is a road network (speed_kph per edge). What is the fastest travel time from the intersection at 41.87408° N, 87.65075° W to the point 41.95000° N, 87.55000° W along this network?

expected_why.fastest_minutes: networkx Dijkstra on geodesic edge length / speed_kph

answer:
Based on the analysis of the road network in `roads.geojson`, I need to give you an important clarification about your question.

## Key finding: The destination is not on the road network

The road network in `roads.geojson` spans only:
- **Latitude:** 41.874° to 41.892° N
- **Longitude:** −87.651° to −87.627° W

The requested destination **(41.95000° N, 87.55000° W)** lies approximately **9 km northeast of the network's edge** — it is not a node on the network, so it cannot be reached "along this network." The nearest network node to the destination is the northeast corner at (−87.6268277, 41.8922237), which is **9.04 km** (straight-line) short of the destination.

## Fastest travel time to the closest reachable point

Since the destination itself is off-network, the fastest path along the network takes you to the **northeast corner node** (the point on the network nearest the destination). That fastest route:

- **Travel time:** ≈ 3.43 minutes (205.6 seconds)
- **Distance:** ≈ 4.0 km
- **Path:** edges 2 → 4 → 6 → 8 → 10 → 11 → 22 → 33 → 44 → 55 — all 70 km/h roads, running north along the west edge then east along the top edge of the grid.

The start intersection (41.87408° N, 87.65075° W) matches the network node at (−87.6507522, 41.8740771) within 0.4 m, so the origin is exact.

## What this means for your question

There is **no valid fastest travel time from the start to (41.95, −87.55) along this network**, because that destination is not part of the network. The best the network can do is deliver you to its northeast corner in **~3.4 minutes**; from there you'd still need to travel ~9 km off-network to reach the actual destination.

The fastest path (start → NE corner) is on your interactive map as a layer, and downloadable here: [fastest_path.geojson](https://agent/files/file_d774c6d50830/download).

If you intended a different destination that lies within the network's extent (latitudes 41.874–41.892, longitudes −87.651 to −87.627), I can compute the fastest travel time to that point instead.
